code.originalText: Gout, stone prevention, kidney, and blood pressure review at about six months

text.paragraph: Gout, stone prevention, kidney, and blood pressure review at about six months. [S]

Mr. Franklin returns about six months after starting urate-lowering therapy. He had one gout flare, in the left knee ten weeks ago, treated with five days of prednisone; the knee culture grew nothing, and he has had no flare since. The potassium and urate checks planned for two to five weeks after his last visit were not drawn until that sick visit, at seven weeks. He takes allopurinol 300 mg, colchicine 0.6 mg, losartan, atorvastatin, and potassium citrate. His home jug shows about 2.3 L of urine a day. His home blood pressure averages 128/76. He voids well, with nocturia once. He walks 30 minutes most days and has lost 3 kg. [S]

Gout at target (M1A.0710). Serum urate 5.4 mg/dL on allopurinol 300 mg, below the target of 6. The July value of 5.9 was drawn during a flare and was not relied on. Prophylaxis has now run more than six months, with no flare for ten weeks. [S]
Continue allopurinol 300 mg daily long term.
Stop colchicine today.
Serum urate every six months.
Flare plan: start prednisone at the first sign and call.

Uric acid stone prevention (N21.0). Urine pH 6.3, within the 6.0 to 6.5 goal, on potassium citrate; urine output about 2.3 L a day, close to the goal. [S]
Continue potassium citrate and fluids.
Urine pH with each six-monthly check.

Chronic kidney disease G3a A1 (N18.31). Creatinine 1.32 mg/dL, eGFR 56, potassium 4.6 mmol/L, stable on losartan and potassium citrate. [S]
Yearly eGFR, urine albumin-creatinine ratio, hemoglobin, and kidney failure risk in March.
Continue atorvastatin.

Hypertension (I10). 128/76 mmHg in the office and at home, below 130/80. The KDIGO systolic target below 120 was discussed; he prefers not to add a second drug at his age. [S]
Continue losartan 50 mg.

Benign prostatic hyperplasia after resection (N40.1). IPSS 5 and residual 30 mL five months after surgery. [S]
Yearly IPSS.
